title: 第十三章 天蚕的反哺
slug: 重生末日最强生存系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林夕迅速的冲到马洁面前，手中寒月剑光闪过大喝道：“第一剑绝！”

随着林夕一剑斩下，黑猫顿时发出一声哀嚎，随后便看到一条尾巴掉落在地上。

黑猫顿时跑掉了，林夕看到黑猫跑掉并没有硬追，而是低头看着马洁的伤势。

此时的马洁蹲在地上痛苦的不断颤抖，林夕立即将精神探入到系统页面。

“系统，这是你让我救的人！她现在有生命危险，你快点出手救救她！”

“本系统只为宿主一人服务“

”为我一人服务是吧，那我现在命令你，救她!“

“本系统只为宿主一人服务“

“你服务个屁！我让你救她，这不算服务吗！”林夕大声地喊道

”本系统只为宿主一人服务“

随着系统的第三遍提示音的出现，林夕的精神力顿时被弹出了系统的页面

林夕懊恼的锤了锤地面，此时马洁虚弱的声音传出：“林夕，我是不是要变成丧尸了。”此时的马洁已经变得精神模糊，已经看不清楚任何事物，包括感受不到疼痛了。

林夕看着已经逐渐发黑的伤口强忍着说道：”不会的，不会的，只是简单的挠伤，我让张常去找消炎药了，你坚持坚持，他马上就回来了。“

马洁听到林夕的安慰，笑了笑说道：”才不是呢，那可是变异的小猫咪。“

说完这句话，马洁便昏了过去，林夕能够明显的感觉到马洁体内的气息开始变得不稳定起来，这说明马洁已经开始变异了。

林夕一屁股坐在了地上神色低沉的看着马洁，孙悦此时走了上拍了拍林夕的肩膀说道：”你，尽力了，这是她自己的选择。“

林夕没有说话，突然，林夕猛地站了起来，死死的盯着马洁。

Page (1/3)

Lin Xi quickly rushed to Ma Jie, the Hanyue sword flashed in her hand and shouted: "The best sword!"

As Lin Xi slashed down with his sword, the black cat immediately let out a wail, and then saw a tail falling to the ground.

The black cat ran away immediately. Lin Xi saw the black cat running away and did not chase after it. Instead, she looked down at Ma Jie's injury.

At this time, Ma Jie was squatting on the ground and shaking in pain. Lin Xi immediately put her mind into the system page.

"System, this is the person you asked me to save! Her life is in danger now, please hurry up and save her!"

"This system only serves the host."

"You serve me alone, right? Then I order you now to save her!"

"This system only serves the host."

"You're such a jerk! I asked you to save her. Isn't this considered service?" Lin Xi shouted loudly

"This system only serves the host."

As the system's third prompt sounded, Lin Xi's mental energy was immediately ejected from the system's page.

Lin Xi hammered the ground in frustration, and then Ma Jie's weak voice came out: "Lin Xi, am I going to become a zombie?" At this time, Ma Jie had become mentally confused and could no longer see anything clearly, including the fact that she could no longer feel pain.

Lin Xi looked at the wound that was gradually turning black and said with restraint, "No, no, it's just a simple scratch. I asked Zhang Chang to find anti-inflammatory medicine. Just hold on, he'll be back soon."

When Ma Jie heard Lin Xi's comfort, she smiled and said, "That's not true, that's a mutated kitten."

After saying this, Ma Jie fainted. Lin Xi could clearly feel that the breath in Ma Jie's body began to become unstable, which meant that Ma Jie had begun to mutate.

Lin Xi sat down on the ground and looked at Ma Jie with a low expression. Sun Yue walked up and patted Lin Xi on the shoulder and said, "You, try your best. This is her own choice."

Lin Xi didn't speak. Suddenly, Lin Xi stood up suddenly and stared at Ma Jie.
